run_create_ops_docs: run the script to parse GGML backend CSV files and generate an ops.md documentation table
build_ops_markdown_table: build a markdown table of GGML operations and their backend support status from CSV files
test_backend_support_status: test the backend support status for a specific GGML operation across all backends
summarize_operation_support: summarize whether a GGML operation is fully supported, partially supported, or unsupported
review_docs_generator_class: review the DocsGenerator class that parses CSV files and generates GGML ops documentation
